title: [Track P / v0-M7 Stage2B3a][RELEASED Gate0-first] Authentic H-arm T Copy caller snapshot seal
body:
Track: Coordination → **Track P (Production Compiler / source-issued proof precision) — v0-M7 Stage2B3a**.

# Stage2B3a — faithfully seal actual completed H success-arm caller graph for T Copy public proof

**STATUS: INTAKE HOLD UNTIL SEPARATE C EXPLICIT RELEASE COMMENT.** This is a NEW narrowly bounded trusted source-issuer precision implementation candidate; not a generalized owner/CFG/MIR, not backend C17 expansion, not a canonical source change. **First preflight MUST determine whether existing Draft17.34 and already-issued source rights suffice**. No code changes before preflight written to this Issue.

## Authority and provenance
- **Compiler/main fixed at RELEASE `77d83dfc00850b14fd7c3bc95e7e3c12e34161fb`**, [CURRENT_SPEC](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/blob/main/docs/reference/CURRENT_SPEC.md) → **Draft17.34**, especially §16.3.8 exactly one recursive H and one ordinary two-u8 T in a single semantic unit; §§17–18 source/known-call/arm composition, §20 ref/currentness/source-issued proof, §24 nonCopy/affine, §26–27 match/IF; [Backend Contract v0.4](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/blob/main/docs/reference/NewLang_Backend_Contract_v0_4.md) and current [Process §4.2/§4.3/§4.3.2](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/blob/main/docs/NewLang_Project_Development_Process.md). No change to grammar/normal v0 source rules.
- Previous corrected integrated P [#779](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/pull/779), new main same candidate Git tree; natural main FULL5 [#39945752721](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/actions/runs/39945752721) **5×443 PASS**, NO-LLVM PARTIAL [#39945752657](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/actions/runs/39945752657) **442 PASS**. [Independent R #780 C ACCEPT finite A-only calibrated PASS](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/780#issuecomment-6363719890); original [R #776 FIRST-PASS BLIND COVERAGE FAIL](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/776#issuecomment-6361332793) untouched and remains FAIL.
- C accepted [Track M #783 exact first predicate/alternatives](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/783#issuecomment-6364093398), [C decision](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/783#issuecomment-6364116563). Track B [#782 terminal architecture report](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/782#issuecomment-6364037700): KEEP direct C17 baseline, upstream proof precision3 is independent of backend choice. B thin-plan comparative work is separate, not a P3a implementation dependency.
- Frozen independent **R-B** source in merged tree `tests/p778/external_r776/positive_t_interposed.nl` (original authored R #776, SHA256 **`12c5c66c413a57fd78549cb4563c71c6831d0f151b53b2d4569d32f7b50a1af5`**), frozen oracle `tests/p778/external_r776/oracle.json` original SHA256 `2c14f494b84c0bfe9a93500fa962e7fa163d798f5cd9a900353189b42fca7a22`; DO NOT MODIFY their bytes or original R evidence/oracle/BLIND verdict. R-B is actual H Some arm with T stateful Copy call74 AFTER H nonCopy producer/local RETURN. Ordinary source CHECK0; actual public body+parameters validator **precision3**, C17 CLI4 / zero stdout C, named output sentinel preserved. R-A fixed `positive_h_first.nl` source SHA256 `a516361123d26de17ac6e5f9a81cc530f50b6509379a960ca20e78a2df0b6a0d`, body+parameters public0/C17/native is regression.
- M's exact causal finding: `src/copy_body.c::parameter_entry` first `!p->caller_nodes`, because `nl_copy_body_seal` snapshots child caller graph for **direct completed function fragment F** via its `bodies[]`, but the real T call proof B belongs to a separately completed **match-arm A.bodies[]** under `parent.arms[]`. No issuer-owned finished A snapshot is attached; body and parameters share first status3. Existing call node/body owner/entry/handoff alone do not certify the missing graph. Subsequent replay/scope/ValueFact may still fail. No public API can legitimately synthesize the snapshot after the fact.

## Execution / isolation
**MODE: P-EQUIVALENT WORK/CODEX environment** with normal production compiler development, clean new dedicated **P-only branch** from exact fixed main, one **DRAFT / DO NOT MERGE** PR, local genuine source/check/proof/negative/OOM tests and natural `pull_request` GitHub Actions. Do **NOT** use R-owned branch or R-equivalent BLIND stage to tune Production expectations. Never modify/rebase/merge old R #777/#781 or prior P #775/#779; leave original snapshots and first failures immutable. No self-merge/issue close or automatic R start.

## Mandatory Gate0 before edits
Write Issue comment with `GATE0 / SOURCE-ISSUER SEMANTIC PRECISION OR STOP`: exact frozen source/test hashes, current R-A/B public and CLI status on baseline, issuer lineage A match-arm root→`A.bodies[]`→B call74, source/body owner/world/dependency and completion immutability, complete candidate small write-set/transaction timing and first potential falsifier. Evaluate §4.2 Historical Design Intent: if **no new source entitlement/proof kind** and strictly reuse existing issuer-owned caller graph snapshot closure, classify faithful precision implementation; if need to mint new authority or broader graph relation/semantics, **STOP** and request M/C plus independent F design review. Contrast alternatives: safe existing fail-closed; proposed true arm completion snapshot; larger arm/parent public receipt (NOT authorized); validator bypass (REJECT). Confirm no P work touching backend to mask precision problem.

## Authorized conditional implementation (only after Gate0 faithful existing issuer)
- **Exactly** at real completed **A** match arm's trusted issuer lifecycle / before owned arm publication or move into parent, ensure existing source-owned call B receives immutable snapshot of **the actual A nodes/source/root/count/body and exact world, original completed call node/loan/field/entry/handoff**, **only for direct A.bodies[] with proven `child->caller==A`**, preserving parent arms variant/index owner relation and exact context. Prefer minimal re-use/extraction of already-trusted direct-body `nl_copy_body_seal` logic. Treat nested arms/calls explicitly, NEVER attach an unrelated parent F or sibling arm and never infer authenticity from same numeric IDs alone. Caller graph seal lifetime must survive until public validator use, not duplicate authority.
- Handle allocation failure transactionally: if capture/copy of A node snapshot fails, **do not publish A, alter parent / sibling/world / original stored proofs, or partially emit C**. Resource cleanup and clean retry from unchanged source/checker expected. Preserve every genuine allocation / Domain / Backing / original H owner permission. No partial copy body snapshot or leaked privileged pointer; all proof attachments must be either fully published or revoked on error.
- Test **unchanged frozen R-B public** `nl_checked_copy_body_validate` and `nl_checked_copy_body_parameters_validate` for call74 **both `NL_CHECK_OK`**, with exact stored caller source/graph/root/count/owner/world; ensure full Copy event replay, formal/actual substitution, current ValueFact/sibling/writer and actual source world match. **Do not alter true R-B emitter status**: regular CLI and `--emit-c17-to` MUST still reject this B profile (CLI4 V1-BACKEND-UNSUPPORTED, zero stdout C, named sentinel unchanged). R-B native **NOT TESTED** until separate Stage2B3b authorization. Preserve R-A public0 and existing direct functions p713/p718/p728 public validators/normal CLI behavior; no new source syntax/semantics/back-end emitter changes.
- At least **4 distinct P-owned CTest names (K≥4)** covering (1) actual R-B source arm proof/parameters validate, (2) alternate valid independently P-frozen R-B-like source with meaningful naming/index/values variation **frozen before implementation tests**, (3) malicious proof/world/graph negative hardening and existing R negatives, (4) actually reached issuer snapshot OOM rollback plus retry and unchanged owner worlds; optionally separate (5) C17 named-fail-closed regression. All sources/outcomes/freeze SHA recorded. Baseline full 443 / noLLVM 442; target **FULL5 443+K / PARTIAL 442+K** on same current branch HEAD, no CTest removal/exclusion. Exactly one **natural first pull_request attempt1 FULL5 + PARTIAL** complete pair on stable candidate. If CI first failure is mechanical harness-only, STOP for separate C §7.6 waiver; semantic/public/origin/rollback/ASan/UBSan failures stop substantive attempts. Preferred modest code diff in trusted issuer family (e.g. `src/copy_body.c`, `src/semantic_check.c`, minimal private header only if needed) + tests and CMake, not general compiler refactor.
- Public negative requirements with *actual first failure stage* recorded and original source preserved: **wrong arm parent/variant/index** (including same-number alien-world), **wrong call/loan graph/root/count/order/source** (even if B body same), **wrong copy ValueFact/field index old vs current sibling**, **foreign formal/actual/entry/handoff**, **H nonCopy duplicate/wrong Allocation/Domain/Backing**, **snapshot/OOM/rollback** for real newly reachable allocation(s). If cannot build one negative without new test-only issuer rights, report NOT TESTED and propose independent R after candidate, don't fabricate. Cross-world numeric collision must never pass just because source-derived IDs match.
- **First-predicate STOP**: if `caller_nodes` now present but any next `NL_CHECK_ANALYSIS_PRECISION_LIMIT` / invalid replay / authority mismatch remains in B, do not weaken validator or broadly extend scope to make code native. Submit limited failure report with first next exact predicate and leave CLI fail-closed. If initial Graph completion alone cannot be shown safe (partial A publication, alias lifetime, parent arms world), STOP and report. CI/ASan errors due substantive change also STOP. No trust expansion, mixed H/T general effects, generated C17 modifications, backend support for arm T, LLVM/Checked MIR, concurrency or general FFI in this task.

## Reporting/acceptance and onward gates
Deliver a **P-only DRAFT PR** (even if HOLD, with evidence and bounded safe changes only) and final Issue comment listing fixed base/candidate SHA, exact code/issuer source-line changes, before/after genuine public and CLI statuses, first initial failures/historical evidence, source hashes and original H/T roots/ValueFacts/loan effects, negative/OOM/fail worlds, exact local and first natural CI counts/names/checks and STOP. Verdict explicitly `STAGE2B3a PUBLIC ARM PROOF: CANDIDATE PASS / REVIEW REQUIRED`, `STOP: FIRST NEXT PREDICATE ...`, or `STOP: NEW AUTHORITY DESIGN REQUIRED`. **P does not self-merge, self-close, approve B3b, or launch independent R**.
Coordination alone next adjudicates candidate + separate **fresh FIRST-PASS BLIND R** on independent R branch+Actions for new issuer trust (if P candidate), with source/oracle SHA frozen before P source or report; R later may also test B3b as its own stage, not retrospectively certify new issuer. Stage2B3b/backend remains hold until source-issued proof first independently validated. Product GO #624 PAUSED/H1 #268 HOLD; C-vs-well-factored-C UB-prevention author+ordinary-safe caller audit closure UNMEASURED. This is capability validation, not a general soundness theorem.

**Goal/Evidence/Alternatives/STOP (§4.3)**: goal improve ordinary selected H/T source composability without new rights; evidence M #783 first true caller snapshot missing and original R-B proven CHECK0/public3/CLI4; alternatives safe existing refusal / correct bounded issuer sealing / unselected new receipt schema / separate MIR research. STOP on new world/permission/type rules, need generalized recursive proof sealing, stale/alien graph accepted, dirty OOM, backend scope escape, CI trust downgrade. **Process §4.3.2** prioritizes true v0 dependency and reusable correction, not per-fixture special case.
